messages:
Taylor Rivera: Hey folks 12 urgent please  newborn arrived while we were transiting between airports, hospital billed under the mother's (my partner) local travel name and we don't have the US birth certificate or SSN yet. Collections called. Need: (1) temporary dependent coverage letter to show provider, (2) replacement digital insurance card, (3) confirm whether payroll will start charging premiums before final docs.
Sam Bennett: Congrats Taylor! Short checklist: temporary coverage letter + provisional enrollment flag, temporary digital card (mobile wallet) for the pediatrician, and claims note for international/alternate-name births. We can do provisional coverage effective DOB pending docs.
Taylor Rivera: Awesome. The hospital invoice lists the newborn as "Infant of Rivera" (no first name) and the mom was billed under her passport name which is different from her familiar name. Will that block things?
Sam Bennett: Not usually. Carrier will accept provisional docs that link the parents to the child (hospital invoice + signed attestation from the birthing parent + travel docs). We just need a notarized affidavit of parentage or placement letter in cases of unusual naming.
Benefits Bot: Temporary proof-of-coverage letter generated (ID TMP-PA-331). Valid 30 days from issue. This letter confirms provisional medical coverage effective on DOB and requests provider to hold collections pending final docs. Download: https://internal.benefits.redwood/letters/TMP-PA-331
Taylor Rivera: Thank you! Can you also push a digital insurance card to the mobile wallet right away so the pediatrician can scan it?
Sam Bennett: Yes. We can issue a temporary digital card (QR + policy reference) tied to the provisional enrollment. It will be visible in the health portal within 1 hour. Use filename convention when uploading: empID_lastname_tempdoc.pdf (e.g., 33421_Rivera_temp.pdf). PDFs or PNGs accepted.
Carrier Rep - Aetna: Hi Taylor  opened an expedited file. For claims routing please add claim note "ALT-NAME-NEO" and attach hospital invoice + TMP-PA-331. If provider billed the mother, include authorization to discuss patient info. We'll triage for direct payment or EOB to route to collections team. Expect carrier ACK in 48 hrs.
Taylor Rivera: Payroll asked whether we'll see a premium deduction this payroll cycle for the dependent if it's provisional.
Payroll Bot: Payroll policy: provisional enrollments do not trigger immediate deductions until Benefits confirms backdate in the system. If finalized retro to DOB, Payroll will apply a pro-rated premium adjustment on the next payroll run. Refunds/charges will be reflected as a single-line adjustment.
Sam Bennett: I'll escalate to carrier and notify Collections ops to pause external collection while TMP-PA-331 is in effect. Taylor  DM me the hospital invoice and a scanned notarized affidavit (if you have it) so I can attach to the carrier ticket.
Taylor Rivera: DM'd invoice and a signed travel affidavit. Also lost the physical insurance card during travel 12 will the digital card be accepted at the in-network pediatric clinic?
Carrier Rep - Aetna: Most in-network clinics accept the digital card + TMP letter for verification. If any clinic refuses, have them call provider services and reference policy number on the TMP document. We'll confirm network status and call the clinic directly if needed.
Taylor Rivera: You're all lifesavers  will follow up if they resume collections. Appreciate the quick help. :pray:
